ZH_updates.Here are six hundred dots, scattered com: 这里有600个点，完全随机地散落着。<bookmark mark='a'/>现在让它们各自游走。每一步都加上一个随机踢动和一个漂移：当前位置的一半，再加上分数。绿色箭头只显示分数的方向，长度经过了缩放。<bookmark mark='b'/>看这些随机运动会构建出什么。
ZH_updates.This is, in miniature, how today's image: 这就是今天图像和视频生成器工作方式的一个缩影。它们从噪声出发，通过一步步随机运动，流成一幅图。<bookmark mark='a'/>这里的分数，是从我们的玩具字母分布精确计算出来的。生成模型学习的是分数这一部分，另一项漂移则是已知的。我们会在第21部分搭建它。

obsolete_keys.Here are six hundred dots, scattered com: Here are six hundred dots, scattered completely at random. <bookmark mark='a'/> Now let each one wander. Each step adds a random kick and a drift: the current position divided by two, plus the score. The green arrows show only score directions, with their lengths rescaled. <bookmark mark='b'/> Watch what the randomness builds.
obsolete_keys.This is, in miniature, how today's image: This is, in miniature, how today's image and video generators work. They start from noise and let it flow, one random step at a time, into a picture. <bookmark mark='a'/> Here the score is computed exactly from our toy letter distribution. A generative model learns the score component; the other drift term is already known. We'll build it in part twenty-one.

voiceovers.en: Here are six hundred dots, scattered completely at random. <bookmark mark='a'/> Now let each one wander. Each step adds a random kick and a drift: the current position divided by two, plus the score. The green arrows show only score directions, with their lengths rescaled. <bookmark mark='b'/> Watch what the randomness builds.
voiceovers.old_en: Here are six hundred dots, scattered completely at random. <bookmark mark='a'/> Now let each one wander. At every moment it gets a small random kick, plus a gentle push from a field of arrows. <bookmark mark='b'/> Watch what the randomness builds.
voiceovers.zh: 这里有600个点，完全随机地散落着。<bookmark mark='a'/>现在让它们各自游走。每一步都加上一个随机踢动和一个漂移：当前位置的一半，再加上分数。绿色箭头只显示分数的方向，长度经过了缩放。<bookmark mark='b'/>看这些随机运动会构建出什么。

voiceovers.en: This is, in miniature, how today's image and video generators work. They start from noise and let it flow, one random step at a time, into a picture. <bookmark mark='a'/> Here the score is computed exactly from our toy letter distribution. A generative model learns the score component; the other drift term is already known. We'll build it in part twenty-one.
voiceovers.old_en: This is, in miniature, how today's image and video generators work. They start from noise and let it flow, one random step at a time, into a picture. <bookmark mark='a'/> The arrows are the whole secret: they're what a network learns. We'll build them in part twenty-one.
voiceovers.zh: 这就是今天图像和视频生成器工作方式的一个缩影。它们从噪声出发，通过一步步随机运动，流成一幅图。<bookmark mark='a'/>这里的分数，是从我们的玩具字母分布精确计算出来的。生成模型学习的是分数这一部分，另一项漂移则是已知的。我们会在第21部分搭建它。
